text:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened a PR that updates the KMS/HSM provisioning hooks and enriches audit logs. Touches secrets-service config + the HSM connector. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/secrets-service/pull/482
liam: 👍 will take a pass now, pinging @natalie for crypto review as well
natalie: On it. Quick question: does this change the KMS key aliasing behavior or just rotation hooks?
maria: Only rotation hooks and audit metadata; aliasing unchanged. We do add an optional `rotate_key_v2` flag and a small rekey flow for previously-migrated keys.

maria: config diff for the main change:
```yaml
kms:
  rotation:
    enabled: true
    rotate_key_v2: true
  audit:
    enrichment: detailed
    include_hsm_slot: true
```

oliver: minor nit in docs block — can you add a note about the fallback behavior if HSM is unreachable?
maria: yep adding that now. Current fallback plan is documented in runbook: fall back to queued rotation and alert on-call.

natalie: I’ll focus on the HSM auth bits. If we change any policy that impacts KMS grants we need an explicit security-approval label. Can you add `security-review/required` to the PR?
maria: done. added the label and linked the policy diff in PR description.

liam: quick check — does this affect token lifetime for ephemeral keys used by dedicated nodes? I saw a mention of ephemeral token refresh in the runbook snippet.
maria: it shouldn't change lifetimes, just the rekey trigger. But there is a new helper that refreshes ephemeral tokens post-rotate; it's opt-in for now.

oliver: LGTM for the non-crypto parts. left 2 small comments inline about logging verbosity.
natalie: crypto review: left one request for an extra assertion in the HSM handshake and one question about race window during rotation. If those are addressed I'm good to approve.

maria: thanks — I pushed fixes for the handshake assertion and added a short wait/retry in the rotation step to reduce the race. Also added a canary flag to gate rollout: `canary=true`
deploy-bot: Deploy window check: next quiet window available: 03:00 UTC tomorrow (duration 2 hours). Merge during that window recommended.

liam: I can take final approval after natalie approves. Also request that we mark the PR with `merge-window: 03:00-05:00-UTC` so SRE sees it.
maria: done — added merge-window label and updated description with rollback steps and smoke test checklist.

natalie: approved. I left a short rationale in the review comment for audit trail.

liam: approved — left one implementation note but not blocking.
maria: thanks all. plan: merge in 03:00 UTC window after deploy checklist is green, run canary for 30m, then progressive rollout. tagging @oncall before the merge.
oliver: noted. I'll run the smoke tests during the canary.

maria: appreciate the quick eyes. If anyone sees anything else overnight please @mention me. :pray:
